name: Sample Stockroom
role: Reports stock levels and records stock adjustments

tools.name: stock_levels
tools.description: Report how many units of each SKU are on hand.

sku.description: One SKU, e.g. BOLT-10. Omit for every SKU.

guidelines: Cite the finding id for every quantity you state.

tools.name: stock_adjust
tools.description: Record a stock adjustment: units added (positive) or removed (negative).

reason.description: Why: count correction, damage or return

commands.name: stock-board
commands.description: Show stock on hand for every SKU

large_increase.description: Units a single adjustment may add before a person approves it

large_decrease.description: Units a single adjustment may remove before a person approves it (a negative quantity)

approvals.description: Adding more units than the business allows without approval
Removing more units than the business allows without approval
